recommendations.executive_summary: The Artisanal Single-Origin Kopi Bar presents a moderate risk with a candidate price of S$5.00, which exceeds the Optimal Price Point (OPP) of S$4.47 but remains below the Point of Marginal Expensiveness (PME) of S$5.34. Despite a mean purchase intent of 66.8% and a positive sentiment score, significant price sensitivity is observed among core demographic segments, particularly seniors and working-class consumers. To enhance market viability, strategic adjustments in pricing and value offerings are crucial to attract a broader customer base in Ang Mo Kio.

recommendations.recommended_pivot: Reposition the price to S$4.50, aligning closer to the Optimal Price Point while implementing a value bundling strategy that includes a toast set with each kopi purchase. Additionally, accept CDC vouchers to enhance accessibility and appeal to cost-sensitive consumers. Promote an off-peak discount for morning and afternoon purchases to drive traffic during quieter hours.
